title: The New Year Took Up Its Grammar

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The year turned in the night and the pots stood where they had stood. The fire kept four pulls and wanted a fifth, and the hand went to the slate before the eye went up. Word came up that a man was still set below the bridge, and nobody said the landing was a door.
epigraph.attribution: A Low Kiln saying, kept after the Five

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and ninety-six to three hundred and ninety-eight days, six months and two hundred and sixteen to two hundred and eighteen days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft and the back room remain a sound and a shape from below, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, the soft-cuffed clerk at the out-of-line landing a reported shape and not a sighting that makes him a witness. Each morning the register takes the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool; the empty place beside it holding the fold of wool Sella put there on the fifteenth, found where put and still a finding, not a placing; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — while the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrels without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning. Three ordinary tending days after the turn: the household goes back to its grammar as though nothing had turned, no slate is opened within reach of the basket, no figure is given for the boy, and the carried fire from a payer nobody names answers four low pulls with the fifth still missing. The chapter's one meaningful change is planted on Ilmen 3: word comes up that the soft-cuffed clerk is still set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge with a slate turned inward for a measure nobody has called; he calls nothing, writes no name and is made no witness, the boy files the order of reaching apart from every other hand with no tenth standing, and Tarn's head goes a degree toward the landing and back to the broom without a word — the first movement linking an ended term and a valuable ear to the people who would measure it, a seed and not a payment, a hearing or a seventh.

scenes.title: The Grammar of the Turned Year
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{396}{Ilmen 2, Y.H. 814, Secondday}: the small hours opening the first tend-day after the turn, then first light and the morning under the Vail kiln-house roof. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects only (salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease on the peg, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line at the Vail corner with its finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, twice-mended pot's hairline between old-brass staple and tighter wire, unforged collector sentence at the kindling, uncalled tile debt). Walk-ons only: neighbours going about an ordinary morning in the Clay Yard. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards — the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions stand where put, do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). New day, new date, no recap: nothing from the turn crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; Ilmen 2 is a tend-day on which the household goes back to its grammar as though nothing had turned, and no tend-day is set against a holy day (T071/T072 with T088). Dramatic purpose: the boy carries twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 across into Y.H. 814 unchanged behind one unsigned figure — twelve are twelve and not one account, the figure read is still not the figure paid, no signature stands on the space and no doctrine comes out of twelve — while the tend's reset supplies no payer to the old twelve or to a new one; Ilmen 10 (Day 404) stands eight mornings off, a reset and not a signing, and is not brought into a morning that has not earned it (T015/T041/T047 advanced, not paid). The surgeon takes the body in its old order and knows a face composed by cold is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from the outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core; the infant wants the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw and turns them with the back of a broken pot, counts a small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger above the unread charcoal and her lips on a two-gapped row, glances once at the clay jar under lead glaze with her hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark hangs where it hung; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule, and the household's returning to grammar is not made an eighth opening. The carried fire answers four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer without a name for three hundred and ninety-six days, and Garl's name is unspoken the same number, the two standing side by side without becoming one (T088, T009/T013/T092). The keeping at the fold is found where put on the morning and is still a finding, not a placing, a habit, a way, a gift or a payment; a second placing would want a hand that placed twice and a third a way, both wanting a payer where none stands (T097/T060/T086). The file comes out on the towel as instruments come out when a case is done and the hand comes down on answer 367, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across none of the kept things. Count 396 exact, six months and two hundred and sixteen days told by nobody. Foreshadowing: the reset gathers toward the new year's first reading on Ilmen 10, which must begin a new count and not stand up as a payer or a doctrine; the unnamed giver of the fire gathers toward the naming of the Hearth as a wound. Paid off: nothing. No sixth hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, signature, payer, witness, reader, payment, third crust or ending.

scenes.title: The Seventh at the Lip
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 2 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 368 and the count standing at 396 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and the cold damper on the afternoon; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours at the kindling and along the yard. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, called collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no runner came on any road and no ownerless voice came over the boards. Dramatic purpose: Tarn stands at the very end of a term already ended with six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the very edge of its sill; his hand goes over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the coming away the whole of the checking, and he tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, cutting, counting and spending nothing (T036/T076/T006, T009/T013/T092 advanced, not paid). The ear-sentence about an ear under this roof being worth more than the debt that holds it is found where it stopped at the calling word at the end of the term — a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth stood up — and the Seed 16 breath is unspent, the loan uncalled, the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his without a figure and a want he did not voice for a slate with his own name and no mark against it; a term ending is not a payment, a forgiveness or a freedom but leaves a man more exposed than it found him, and this is carried, not spent. The Ash 14 held breath at the sill and the Bone 26 thumb's resting are found where put and not made again, beside the five held objects and the pot-crack resting with a finger between every pair, not a sixth held object, not a tenth stopping and with no payer standing (T061/T082). His chest stays tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at the left wrist giving back the little light, his stroke over the shallow bright flagstones going on without the half-check. Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip; men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and get no name from him and no word that the room is cold. Dusty forearms and clean ones are kept on one tray and parted as clot from vessel; he speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, tells the pot *You'll do* in a voice with no welcome and no unkindness, knows the full note three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds it from any master come up from High Kiln who would call it early, and puts his bent finger into the cold iron of the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and takes it out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time — one piece of iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word covering both mercies (T062/T035/T031 advanced, not paid). *He's not Vail* stays sealed, the promise under the wheel-shed is neither given nor withdrawn, the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, and the four directions stand apart with a finger between every pair and do not repeat (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). The two men are kept on separate trays and not joined into a rule, for a likeness that stands up as one would want a payer and none stood. The yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T098). The file comes out at the going of the light and the hand comes down on answer 368. Foreshadowing: Tarn's ended term and his valuable ear go on gathering toward the exposure planted in Scene 4; Jorra's promise gathers interest against the burned slate and the four directions. Paid off: nothing. No tenth stopping, seventh hearing, eighth opening, witness, reader, payer or ending.

scenes.title: What Came Up the Clay Road
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and the second dated \daymark{397}{Ilmen 3, Y.H. 814, Thirdday}: the small hours opening the day, then first light, a wrong wind off High Kiln and the morning's work, with answer 369 and the count at 397 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: a man come down the clay road from High Kiln with the sweetish green of lead glaze at one mouth-corner; neighbours at the well and the racks. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket and no figure given for the boy; Ilmen 10 stands seven mornings off and is not brought. New day, new date, no recap: nothing from Ilmen 2 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the sweet edge of lead glaze comes and goes over the boards on a wrong wind off High Kiln, the clay jar stands cold under glaze beyond the pot board and Sella shuts her hand half over nothing with the little-door burn closing on air; the sweetish green at the glaze-hand's mouth is a colour on a place of its own, filed beside Berr's green and the greens at past markets but never joined to them and never a name, an eighth sighting, a hearing or a cause (T050/T051 advanced as a sighting only, not paid; never Fenna in the narration). Costs come to the yard as directions and go away as weather: a number rises out of a fist toward the pail and arrives nowhere, a woman asks what the day's work cost and is sent to the pot with *the house has said it*, and the boy files the order of reaching — hand to the record before eye to the person, mouth after both — without making a tenth hand of any of them (T077, T080). Word comes up that a runner went up the clay road before noon with the writing turned to her own sleeve and unread; Hessa's eighth hand stays eighth and she is not made a reader, Ilva's notched strip stays in her sleeve with the count kept in wood and no figure coming off it, and Berr's twelve true subtractions stay locked in his box up the road with the key gone up in a coat pocket that never comes back down and the boy having no key (T080, T015/T041/T047 held). The kept things are found where put: the crust and its hair-lifted corner, the fold in the empty place still a finding and not a placing, the three coverings and the river's winter skin entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, the called-gone grey beside the left-in-place ridge at the Vail corner, the four rooms with the same gap held apart with a finger between every pair and no Court room brought under the roof as a fifth (T097/T060/T086, T083/T085, T009/T013/T092, T081). The cold foot below the sill stays uncured and unnamed and the second chill keeps its withheld cause, carried and not spent (T012/T093/T094/T096). The widow's mark hangs where it hung and no eighth opening is made due, seven openings in seven months being seven and not a rule (T058/T079). The file comes out and the hand comes down on answer 369. Foreshadowing: the green at a mouth gathers toward the far-off ear that will be spoken with it; the unread carrying up the road gathers toward the day a runner must choose whether to read what she carries; the sweet wind gathers toward the naming of the danger that comes with hot clay under tallow and fine grey dust. Paid off: nothing. No eighth sighting, tenth hand, seventh hearing, reader, name, cause, payer or ending.

scenes.title: A Degree Toward the Landing
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Ilmen 3 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 370 and the count standing at 397 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn at the kindling, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge and the cold damper; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: a neighbour come up from below the north bridge with word of the landing, unnamed men going low into the back room before first grey, neighbours at the kindling and the flagstones. No called collector, officer, Berr, Hessa, Ilva, market, Cross or bell; the clerk at the landing is a reported shape seen by nobody under the roof and is made no witness; no ownerless voice came over the boards. New day already dated in Scene 3; nothing crosses forward from the morning as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, planted and NOT paid: word comes up the yard that the soft-cuffed clerk is still set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge with his slate turned inward for a measure nobody has called — cuff soft from washing and folded back twice, gone grey from washing, hand to the slate before eyes to the landing; he calls nothing, writes no name and is made no witness. The boy files the order of reaching on a place of its own apart from every other record-first hand and does not make a tenth of him; the neat dark hand, Marra's, the finger beneath the shelf, Berr's twice-wiped thumb, Hessa's eighth, Ilva's ninth, the Drawing collector's ordinary hand and the Kindling collector's ordinary hand each stay on its own tray, nine hands with no tenth, and the clean voice's speaker stays taken out of his sentences and is not made a tenth hand of, for a clean voice is not a hand (T090/T080, T061/T082 advanced, not paid). Tarn's head goes a degree toward the landing and back to the broom without a word; he takes the broom only after it has been given its instruction, and the stroke goes on over the shallow bright flagstones without a turn of the head and without the half-check, the stones keeping the place where an earlier stroke stopped. This is the first movement joining an ended term and a valuable ear to the people who would measure it — the seed of the far-off day a term that ended leaves a man exposed because his ear makes him valuable — and is expressly not a payment, a hearing, a seventh, a calling of the loan, a tenth stopping, a rule or an argument heard under any roof (T036/T076/T006 advanced, not paid). At the kindling the six stand in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the knife at the very edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, and he tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, cutting, counting and spending nothing; the ear-sentence kept at the calling word, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, the fear of vagrancy and the want for a slate with his own name still his (T036/T076). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey dust white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, men unnamed gone low before first grey; he speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and takes it out without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise is neither given nor withdrawn while the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness and the well-saying at four shapings (T062/T035/T031, T035/T031/T065/T095/T101 held). The boy keeps Tarn's degree-turn and Jorra's promise on two places with a finger between and does not lay them together to make a cause, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. The file comes out at the going of the light; answer 370 filed; count 397 exact, six months and two hundred and seventeen days told by nobody. Foreshadowing planted: the clerk set for an uncalled measure and Tarn's head going a degree toward him gather toward the far-off day the loan that can hear is called against the man who carries it — neither called nor paid here, and the degree not repeated as a habit or a rule in the chapters that follow; Jorra's promise goes on gathering interest against the burned slate at five and the four directions. Paid off: nothing. No tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, seventh hearing, witness, reader, payer, name, arrest, payment or ending.

scenes.title: What the Matter Kept
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and the third dated \daymark{398}{Ilmen 4, Y.H. 814, Fourthday}: the small hours opening the day, then the morning under the Vail roof, with answer 371 and the count at 398 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours keeping the house's arithmetic badly in loaves, glances and an unnamed space at the row's end. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no slate opened within reach of the basket, no figure given for the boy, and Ilmen 10 six mornings off, unbrought. New day, new date, no recap: nothing from Ilmen 3 crosses forward as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the house keeps its days in loaves pushed along a shelf, glances at the clay jar and a space at the row's end nobody calls a number, while the boy keeps three hundred and ninety-eight exact against it and does not stand the number up as a threshold, a doctrine or a figure (T071/T072 advanced, not paid). The surgeon takes the body in its old order — crust, fold, frozen thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for, and that a keeping found where put is still a keeping however many hands find it and a finding is not a placing; the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086). Sella comes to the hearth before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, counts intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turns the dressed grain under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and with no figure or handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark hangs where it hung; a morning, a shelf and a bed are not openings, seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule, and no eighth is made due. The twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 stand unchanged behind one unsigned figure with no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve, and the printed figure stands unchallenged while the figure read is still not the figure paid (T015/T041/T047). The carried fire gives four low pulls with the fifth unpaid and its giver without a name for three hundred and ninety-eight days, and Garl's name is unspoken the same number, the two standing side by side without becoming one (T088, T009/T013/T092). The keeping at the fold, the three coverings and the river's winter skin are found where put and unspent, and the four rooms with the same gap stay four with a finger between every pair (T097/T060/T086, T083/T085, T081). Six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the flat knock of the Drawing outside them on its own place; the heard bell stays in its square beside the told bell, four, four and a gap, its gap not folded into the fire's four and a gap under the floor, the boards' four and four and a knot or the twelve arithmetics behind one figure, and the three counts in three places stay three (T061/T082, T078). The cold foot stays uncured and unnamed and the second chill keeps its withheld cause (T012/T093/T094/T096 carried). The file comes out and the hand comes down on answer 371. Foreshadowing: the field taken as found and left as found gathers toward the far-off hand that will lay the district's private keepings together and call the joining an account, a hand not his and not yet come. Paid off: nothing. No sixth hearing, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, signature, payer, witness, reader, payment, third crust or ending.

scenes.title: Four Low Pulls and the Fifth Unpaid
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Ilmen 4 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 372 and the count at 398 exact. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only: neighbours settling into the ordinary grammar of the tend. No Berr, Hessa, Ilva, Tarn, Jorra, called collector, officer, market, Cross or bell; no ownerless voice over the boards — the four old directions stand where put, do not repeat and buy no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095 held). New day already dated in Scene 5; the afternoon is not made a boundary, a door, a rule or a payment, and nothing crosses back under the roof from the yard as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payer. Dramatic purpose: at the going of the light the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done and before the next is called, and the boy goes over the field by the place of each thing and leaves every gap a gap — the crust's gap, the shelf's two gaps, the gone pan's round ring, the field's empty place, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, the told bell's gap in its square beside the heard bell, the silence after the name from Weighing, the Long Night story's empty name, the place the Remembering did not fill, the neighbour's called-gone grey beside the left-in-place ridge at the Vail corner, Tarn's ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan at the very end of a term already ended, Jorra's promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside the seventh notch, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate at the out-of-line landing and the degree Tarn's head went toward it and back to the broom without a word. The ledger is checked and unchanged: nine record-first hands with no tenth, the clerk at the landing a reported shape and not a tenth hand and no witness; nine stoppings with no tenth and no new stopping made on these three days; six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's flat knock outside them on its own place; the burned-slate word at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, the four directions held apart with a finger between every pair, green a colour and the foundling a shape with no eighth of either and no name given under this roof, the cold foot uncured and unnamed, the cause of the second chill withheld, the river under its winter skin beside water over water, the four rooms with the same gap held apart, the three counts in three places staying three (T080, T061/T082, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101, T050/T051, T033/T034, T012/T093/T094/T096, T083/T085, T081, T078). The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note under the finger's-width door — the inch is not a reach — takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's own finishing under the winter skin, lets it go as the note ended, neither early nor stayed, and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. Answer 372 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the twelve readings, the bell's gap, the flat knock, the child's grey fingertips, the mother's cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river's skin, the widow's mark, the fourth direction, the clerk's inward slate nor the keeping at the fold. Count 398 exact, six months and two hundred and eighteen days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the two standing side by side without becoming one; twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure; Ilmen 10 six mornings off and unbrought. The surgeon takes his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found, every object in its place and nothing laid across anything else, and it costs him nothing, which is how he knows it is not peace; under it, louder, the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread at his mouth wiped and a hand on the pot board's handle, and gets none of the three, the wanting and the having-not going on being the work the way a wound goes on being a wound under a dressing that does not close it. Foreshadowing: the clerk at the landing and the degree-turn go on gathering toward the far-off calling of the loan that can hear; the twelve findings at the shelf and in Berr's locked box, the keeping at the fold and the four rooms' gap gather toward the hand not his that will one day lay the district's private keepings together and call the joining an account; the green, the shape, the unread slate and Ilva's wood go on gathering interest; the fire's unnamed giver gathers toward the naming of the Hearth as a wound. Paid off: nothing. Nothing was opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended; no signature, payer, witness, reader, tenth hand, tenth stopping, eighth opening, seventh hearing, thirteenth arithmetic, figure for the boy, name for a gap or ending. The house goes on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept, forward, not closed.
